newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA RING THE CHANGES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA RING THE CHANGES.

text.p: South Africa, 45-36 winners over Rosario earlier in the week, made five changes and a positional switch on Thursday in their team to play Cuyo in Mendoza next Tuesday.
Exciting Western Province wing Breyton Paulse, the only black player in the squad of 36, comes in for his first game in Springbok colours, replacing Justin Swart on the left wing.

Uncapped Natal centre Jeremy Thompson plays his first game of the tour in place of Joe Gillingham. Flanker Fritz van Heerden moves forward to lock the scrum in place of Hannes Strydom who drops down to the bench.
Wayne Fyvie, the captain, takes over van Heerden's number seven shirt with Griqualant West flank Theo Oosthuizen slotting in on the other side of the scrum.

In the front row prop Toks van der Linde and hooker Henry Tromp make way for Garry Pagel and Chris Rossuow. The changes mean that all 36 members of the squad will have played at least once in the first three tour matches.

15-Russell Bennett; 14-Andre Snyman, 13-Jeremy Thompson, 12-Dick Muir, 11-Breyton Paulse; 10-Franco Smith, 9-Kevin Putt; 8-Schutte Bekker, 7-Wayne Fyvie, 6-Theo Oosthuizen, 5-Krynauw Otto, 4-Fritz van Heerden, 3-Marius Hurter, 2-Chris Rossouw, 1-Garry Pagel.
Replacements: Joggie Viljoen, Justin Swart, Joe Gillingham, Hannes Strydom, Henry Tromp, Toks van der Linde.
